title: What any heat-spreader design search must address

requirements.statement: Steady-state hotspot temperature on the heated face is at or below the design limit.
requirements.rationale: The quantity the spreader exists to control. A one-dimensional resistance estimate may guide a search; it cannot establish the limit because it ignores lateral spreading.

requirements.statement: Areal mass of the plate is at or below the structural limit.
Total plate thickness is at or below the space available.
Temperature at every material interface is at or below that interface's limit.
requirements.rationale: Adhesives, solders, and polymers fail well below the hotspot limit of the metals around them.

requirements.statement: Peak temperature during the declared transient is at or below the design limit.
requirements.rationale: A steady-state search cannot see a start-up or fault overshoot.
